featured_reviews.review_text:
The product selection is good, same as what you would find at our airport souvenir shop or local gifting shops but the staff requires better training.

The lady behind the counter said out loud to the other female colleague "kuch log sirf show off ke liye aate hai". Not sure who she was taking a dig at, we ignored and kept shopping. Same lady made the error of charging us less than what the total was. Store calls us at 10pm informing of this error. I went back to pay but instead of an apology for inconvenience, I was on the receiving end of standoffish behaviour as if it was our fault for the error. I checked with my cousin if I was reading too much into the situation but she agreed too that the behaviour of the staff was odd.

Never ever take their service for decoration of ur venue.. they are highly unprofessional.. they will cheat.. they charged me for 500 balloons but in the venue they only decorated with less than 300 balloons.. when I told the vendor I would count the balloons..he said u won't b able to count.. when we counted.. it was around 273 balloons..never pay them in advance..they didn't complete their work..they came late and work was still on when our guest started coming..

featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you for sharing your feedback regarding our decoration services. It's important for us to understand our customers' experiences and we appreciate your perspective.
Concerning the balloon count, we maintain meticulous records of our installations, which are cross-verified with photographs taken at the event. Our records confirm that we installed 500 balloons as agreed. Balloons often deflate or pop over time, which may have led to the reduced count at the time of your observation. We are committed to improving our communication about such possibilities in the future to avoid any confusion.
We acknowledge your concerns about the timing of our services and the behavior of our team. We set high standards for our team's punctuality and professionalism and are committed to upholding these standards. We will address your feedback with our team to ensure we continue to deliver the best service.
Regarding the errors on your son's birthday banner, we had spoken to your husband about this issue, and he expressed understanding. We also attempted to reach you to discuss the matter, but unfortunately, we were unable to connect. We will continue to reinforce the importance of attention to detail with our team to avoid such errors in the future.
As a practice, we always hand over the items purchased to the customer to avoid such issues. However, we understand that due to other priorities, you were unable to collect the items from the store. We will strive to find a solution that accommodates our clients' schedules in the future.
At the venue, our staff found it challenging to proceed with the decoration without guidance. We will certainly work on improving our coordination with clients to ensure the decor aligns with their preferences.
We are committed to learning from your feedback and improving our services. If you would like to discuss this further, please do not hesitate to contact me directly at our Shop.
Thank you again for your feedback and for giving us the opportunity to learn and grow.

However, the ones I received were feathering and ghosting horribly! I was taken aback and reached out to them to see if they can replace them for me.  They wanted videos, images etc to be shared, which I did. Have attached an image here too.

Inspite of all that, they refuse to acknowledge that there is something wrong with the batch they sent to me. Instead, they just keep sending mail chains and put the onus of returning back the notebooks to them by courier on you. They send you bad products and they want us to take the pain of packing it and couriering it back to them. Their tone of talking to customers is audacious to say the least. Very bad experience and so disappointing.

featured_reviews.name: Dwarkesh Diwan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Infinity Mall in Malad on a Tuesday, and the experience felt like walking into a calm, polished world tucked away from Mumbai’s usual rush. The first thing that struck me was how pleasantly uncrowded the mall was. Unlike weekends where most malls feel like a human maze, this weekday visit felt spacious, relaxed, and perfect for strolling without bumping into bags, elbows, or shopping carts. The floors gleamed like mirrors, reflecting the bright storefronts and giving the whole place a classy, open vibe.

The mall’s layout is clean and well-planned, with popular brands visible right from the central atrium. Stores like Azorte, Trends, Aurelia, Hush Puppies, Pantaloons and many others had bright, inviting displays. The storefronts look lively and modern, and the mall has enough variety to keep both window shoppers and serious shoppers satisfied.

The highlight, and something many malls don’t offer, is the indoor amusement zone with roller coaster rides. Yes, an actual roller coaster inside a mall! It adds a fun twist to the shopping experience, especially for families and kids. Even if you’re not riding, just watching the structure running overhead makes the place feel more like an entertainment hub than just a shopping center.

Food options are also impressive. I stopped by The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf for a warm drink, and the counters looked neat, well-lit, and inviting. The seating area felt relaxed and comfy enough to simply sit and enjoy the mall ambience.

Smart Bazaar inside the mall also deserves a mention. The store was well-stocked and offered some good deals (like Buy 1 Get 1 on water bottles), making it perfect for quick, affordable purchases.

Overall, Infinity Mall, Malad is surprisingly peaceful on weekdays, clean, modern, and full of good food, shopping, and entertainment options. If you want a stress-free mall experience in Mumbai, Tuesday at Infinity Mall is a great choice. Perfect for families, solo visitors, and anyone who enjoys a relaxed day out.
